search.query: index=te_agents sourcetype="silk:router:ipsec" device="IR1101-GO2-01" kind=session | eventstats max(poll_ts) as ult | where poll_ts=ult | eval ifshort=substr(iface,1,2).replace(iface,"^[A-Za-z]+","") | join type=left ifshort [ search index=te_agents sourcetype="silk:router:iface" device="IR1101-GO2-01" | stats latest(alias) as alias by iface | rename iface as ifshort ] | eval nombre=case(isnull(alias),iface, match(alias,"::"), trim(mvindex(split(alias,"::"),1)), true(), alias) | stats max(up) as arriba, values(eval(if(up=1,nombre,null()))) as ifup, count as total | eval Estado=case(total=0,"SIN DATOS",arriba=1,"UP · ".mvjoin(ifup,", "),true(),"DOWN") | eval Color=case(total=0,"#879199",arriba=1,"#53A051",true(),"#DC4E41") | fields Estado Color

index=go2-robot-data sourcetype=robot:gps | head 1 | eval edad=round(now()-_time,0), cls=case(edad>60,"warn",fix>0,"ok",true(),"bad"), estado=case(edad>60,"SIN DATOS RECIENTES",fix>=2,"FIX DGPS",fix=1,"FIX GPS",true(),"SIN FIX"), la=if(fix>0,tostring(round(lat,6)),"sin posición"), lo=if(fix>0,tostring(round(lon,6)),""), pcls=if(fix>0,"coord","coord none"), sat=coalesce(sats_used,0), satsub=if(isnum(sats_view),"usados / ".sats_view." a la vista","usados"), hd=if(isnum(hdop),tostring(round(hdop,1)),"—"), hdq=case(NOT isnum(hdop),"",hdop<1,"excelente",hdop<2,"buena",hdop<5,"moderada",true(),"mala"), alt=if(isnum(alt_m),tostring(round(alt_m,0)),"—"), altu=if(isnum(alt_m),"m",""), vel=if(isnum(speed_kmh),tostring(round(speed_kmh,1)),"—"), velu=if(isnum(speed_kmh),"km/h",""), edadtxt=case(edad<120,"hace ".edad." s",edad<7200,"hace ".round(edad/60,0)." min",true(),"hace ".round(edad/3600,1)." h"), gm=if(fix>0,"https://www.google.com/maps?q=".lat.",".lon,"#"), osm=if(fix>0,"https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=".lat."&mlon=".lon."#map=19/".lat."/".lon,"#"), lnk=if(fix>0,"","off") | fields cls estado la lo pcls sat satsub hd hdq alt altu vel velu edadtxt gm osm lnk

index=te_agents ((sourcetype="silk:router:iface" AND iface IN ("Gi0/0/0","Vl40","Ce0/1/0","Fa0/0/1")) OR sourcetype="silk:router:ipsla") | eval sid=if(isnull(sla_id),null(),tostring(sla_id)) | eval k=case(iface=="Gi0/0/0","stl", iface=="Vl40","ipl", iface=="Ce0/1/0","lte", iface=="Fa0/0/1","lan", sid=="1","stl", sid=="2","lte", sid=="3","ipl", sid=="20","core", sid=="21","gw", sid=="22","splk", sid=="40","app") | where isnotnull(k) | stats latest(oper_status) as oper, latest(in_bps) as ib, latest(out_bps) as ob, latest(speed_mbps) as nom, latest(rtt_ms) as rtt, latest(sense) as sense by k | eval up=if(isnull(oper),null(),if(lower(oper)=="up",1,0)), ok=if(isnull(sense),null(),if(sense=="ok",1,0)), mb=if(isnull(ib),null(),round((ib+ob)/1000000,2)), ut=if(isnull(nom) OR nom<=0,null(),100*(ib+ob)/(nom*1000000)) | eval cls=case(up==0,"down", up==1 AND ok==0,"warn", up==1,"up", isnull(up) AND ok==1,"up", isnull(up) AND ok==0,"down", 1==1,"nd"), mbt=if(isnull(mb),"sin datos", tostring(round(mb,1))." Mbps"), rtxt=case(isnull(ok),"RTT —", ok==0,"sin respuesta", 1==1,"RTT ".tostring(round(rtt,0))." ms"), dur=if(isnull(ut),"3.2", tostring(round(3.2-(min(ut,25)/25)*2.5,2))) | stats values(eval(if(k=="stl",cls,null()))) as stl_cls, values(eval(if(k=="stl",mbt,null()))) as stl_txt, values(eval(if(k=="stl",rtxt,null()))) as stl_rtt, values(eval(if(k=="stl",dur,null()))) as stl_dur, values(eval(if(k=="ipl",cls,null()))) as ipl_cls, values(eval(if(k=="ipl",mbt,null()))) as ipl_txt, values(eval(if(k=="ipl",rtxt,null()))) as ipl_rtt, values(eval(if(k=="ipl",dur,null()))) as ipl_dur, values(eval(if(k=="lte",cls,null()))) as lte_cls, values(eval(if(k=="lte",mbt,null()))) as lte_txt, values(eval(if(k=="lte",rtxt,null()))) as lte_rtt, values(eval(if(k=="lte",dur,null()))) as lte_dur, values(eval(if(k=="lan",cls,null()))) as lan_cls, values(eval(if(k=="lan",mbt,null()))) as lan_txt, values(eval(if(k=="lan",dur,null()))) as lan_dur, values(eval(if(k=="core",cls,null()))) as core_cls, values(eval(if(k=="core",rtxt,null()))) as core_rtt, values(eval(if(k=="gw",cls,null()))) as gw_cls, values(eval(if(k=="gw",rtxt,null()))) as gw_rtt, values(eval(if(k=="splk",cls,null()))) as splk_cls, values(eval(if(k=="splk",rtxt,null()))) as splk_rtt, values(eval(if(k=="app",cls,null()))) as app_cls, values(eval(if(k=="app",rtxt,null()))) as app_rtt | fillnull value="nd" stl_cls ipl_cls lte_cls lan_cls core_cls gw_cls splk_cls app_cls | fillnull value="sin datos" stl_txt ipl_txt lte_txt lan_txt | fillnull value="RTT —" stl_rtt ipl_rtt lte_rtt core_rtt gw_rtt splk_rtt app_rtt | fillnull value="3.2" stl_dur ipl_dur lte_dur lan_dur

index=te_agents sourcetype="silk:router:ipsec" device="IR1101-GO2-01" | eventstats max(poll_ts) as ult | where poll_ts=ult | stats max(eval(if(kind=="session",up,null()))) as tup, max(eval(if(kind=="session",uptime_s,null()))) as ts, dc(eval(if(kind=="sa",spi,null()))) as sas | eval tun_cls=case(isnull(tup),"nd", tup==1,"up", 1==1,"down"), tun_txt=if(isnull(sas) OR sas==0,"sin SA", tostring(sas)." search.query: | mstats avg(network.loss) as v WHERE index=thousandeyes by "thousandeyes.source.agent.name", "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.source.agent.name" as agente, "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where agente="$te_agent$" AND test="$te_test$" | stats avg(v) as v | eval v=round(v,2)

| mstats avg(network.latency) as v WHERE index=thousandeyes by "thousandeyes.source.agent.name", "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.source.agent.name" as agente, "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where agente="$te_agent$" AND test="$te_test$" | stats avg(v) as v | eval v=round(v*1000,1)

| mstats avg(network.jitter) as v WHERE index=thousandeyes by "thousandeyes.source.agent.name", "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.source.agent.name" as agente, "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where agente="$te_agent$" AND test="$te_test$" | stats avg(v) as v | eval v=round(v,1)

search.query: | mstats avg(network.loss) as loss, avg(network.latency) as lat_s, avg(network.jitter) as jitter WHERE index=thousandeyes span=5m by "thousandeyes.source.agent.name", "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.source.agent.name" as agente, "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where agente="$te_agent$" AND test="$te_test$" | eval "Pérdida (%)"=round(loss,2), "Latencia (ms)"=round(lat_s*1000,1), "Jitter (ms)"=round(jitter,2) | fields _time "Pérdida (%)" "Latencia (ms)" "Jitter (ms)"

index=thousandeyes_alerts sourcetype=thousandeyes:agent agent_name="$te_agent$" | stats latest(agent_state) as Estado, latest(last_seen) as "Último contacto", latest(public_ip) as "IP pública", latest(network) as "Red / ISP", latest(location) as Ubicación, latest(ip_addresses) as "IP interna", latest(agent_type) as Tipo | transpose column_name=Campo | rename "row 1" as Valor

| mstats avg(network.loss) as loss, avg(network.latency) as lat, avg(network.jitter) as jit, count(network.loss) as n WHERE index=thousandeyes span=5m by "thousandeyes.test.name", "thousandeyes.source.agent.name", "thousandeyes.test.type" | rename "thousandeyes.test.name" as Test, "thousandeyes.source.agent.name" as Agente, "thousandeyes.test.type" as Tipo | where like(Test, "$te_tag$ - %") | stats sum(n) as Muestras, avg(loss) as loss, avg(lat) as lat, avg(jit) as jit, max(_time) as ultima by Test, Agente, Tipo | eval "Pérdida (%)"=round(loss,2), "Latencia (ms)"=round(lat*1000,1), "Jitter (ms)"=round(jit,2), "Última muestra"=strftime(ultima,"%F %H:%M") | table Test Agente Tipo Muestras "Pérdida (%)" "Latencia (ms)" "Jitter (ms)" "Última muestra" | sort Test

| mstats avg(network.loss) as loss WHERE index=thousandeyes span=5m by "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where like(test, "$te_tag$ - %") | timechart span=5m avg(loss) as "Pérdida (%)" by test

| mstats avg(network.latency) as lat WHERE index=thousandeyes span=5m by "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where like(test, "$te_tag$ - %") | eval lat_ms=lat*1000 | timechart span=5m avg(lat_ms) as "Latencia (ms)" by test
